lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular maxima organized into quasi-vertical columns along the longitudinal axis of the flank, with increasing inter-spot distance observed towards the ventral-posterior region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting with the primary spot centroids to form a discernible grid-like lattice across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear ridge extending from the posterior gill region toward the caudal section, exhibiting a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high-intensity pixels above and shadowed pixels below.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of approximately 6 to 8 distinct high-luminance spots localized within the anterior and medial regions of the first dorsal fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a large commensal fish (remora) attached to the ventral-lateral region beneath the primary lateral ridge.
